name: accent
title: Accent helper
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Helper module (not a component) that repoints the --primary token for one subtree, so a block can take a `color` prop. Install it when a docs example imports `accentStyle` from `@/lib/accent`.
docs: Named exports: accentStyle, accentTokens, accentForeground, resolveAccent, isDefaultAccent, toBlockColor. `accentStyle(color)` returns a style object that sets --primary (and the tokens derived from it) for the element it is spread on; for the default accent it returns an empty object, so the theme keeps control.
